    Description
    ClassMorphViolationException
    Signals that a polymorphic relation met a model class or a type string the morph map does not cover, a port of Laravel's ClassMorphViolationException.
    EloquentException
    The parent of every failure the model layer reports, such as a model that was not found or a relation that is not defined.
    InvalidCastException
    Signals that a cast could not be parsed, applied or reversed for a model attribute.
    InvalidRelationException
    Signals that a model class's relations() map failed its one-time check.
    JsonException
    Signals that text is not valid JSON or that a value cannot be written as JSON.
    LazyLoadingViolationException
    Signals a lazy load while lazy loading is prevented, a port of Laravel's LazyLoadingViolationException.
    MassAssignmentException
    Thrown when a mass assignment names a key the model does not allow, with Laravel's message.
    ModelNotFoundException
    Thrown when a lookup that must find a model finds none, with Laravel's message: "No query results for model [app.User] 1, 2", or "No query results for model [app.User]." when no ids were asked for.
    MultipleRecordsFoundException
    Thrown by EloquentBuilder.sole() when more than one row matches, with Laravel's message "2 records were found.".
    RelationNotFoundException
    Signals that a model class has no relation of a given name, a port of Laravel's RelationNotFoundException.
    UnregisteredModelException
    Thrown when a relation names a model class that has no ModelQuery.of(...) entry yet.
